=== Master Data MVP ===

Reference tables (replicated on Citus workers).

Every table includes a unique URL-safe slug (see column list).

Platform catalog: modules, permissions, module_permissions, system_roles, picklist, picklist_values, module_config_schemas, feature_flags.

Registry audit lives outside this schema (e.g. platform logging or a future module) if required.

Post-launch: healthcare reference data (01-schema-design).
